official: 東京都指定障害児入所施設の人員、設備及び運営の基準に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第3回定例会 提出議案と議決結果

name: 障害児入所施設に性暴力防止措置を義務付け
summary: 都の条例は、指定障害児入所施設の人員や設備、運営の基準を定めています。この議案では、指定福祉型障害児入所施設の設置者に、児童への性暴力の防止や、被害が起きた場合の障害児の保護に必要な措置を義務付けます。令和8年12月25日から施行します。
changes: 施設の設置者に、児童への性暴力を防ぐ措置を義務付ける
障害児と接する一定の従事者について、犯罪事実の確認を義務付ける
性暴力が起きた場合に障害児を保護する措置を義務付ける
who: 指定福祉型障害児入所施設の設置者
施設で障害児と接する一定の従事者
指定福祉型障害児入所施設を利用する障害児
why: 関係する法律の施行と児童福祉法などの改正に伴い、児童への性暴力の防止などに関する規定を設けるためと、都は説明しています。

en.name: Requires residential facilities for children with disabilities to prevent sexual violence
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Standards for Staffing, Facilities, and Operation of Tokyo-Designated Residential Facilities for Children with Disabilities
en.summary: The Tokyo Metropolitan Government's ordinance sets standards for staffing, facilities, and operation at designated residential facilities for children with disabilities. This bill requires operators of designated welfare-type residential facilities for children with disabilities to take measures to prevent sexual violence against children and to protect children with disabilities if harm occurs. It takes effect on December 25, 2026.
changes: Require facility operators to take measures to prevent sexual violence against children
Require criminal-record checks for certain workers who have contact with children with disabilities
Require measures to protect children with disabilities if sexual violence occurs
who: Operators of designated welfare-type residential facilities for children with disabilities
Certain workers who have contact with children with disabilities at the facilities
Children with disabilities who use designated welfare-type residential facilities
en.why: The Tokyo Metropolitan Government says the provisions are being established to prevent sexual violence against children and for other purposes, following the entry into force of relevant laws and amendments to the Child Welfare Act and other laws.
